# abort_criterium_gop {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
abort_criterium_gop(stat, cl, chart_choice)
```
Return `true` if the GOP chart statistic `stat` violates the control limit `cl` (i.e. the chart signals an alarm) for the given chart choice ([`D_Chart`](D_Chart.qmd)`()`, `G_Chart()`, or `Persistence()`). See Equations (18) and (20) in Weiß and Schnurr (2024).
 


:::
